title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.5 - Secure One-Click Updates
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.5 is now available.
Added secure one-click launcher updates with an Update Now button.
Download progress, installation status, retry handling, and manual update checks are now shown inside the launcher.
Every update package is cryptographically verified before Windows installs it.
Launcher releases are distributed separately through the official Spynixx Launcher Notices repository.
